name: x10remote
description: RF/IR remotes for Volumio: wizard to read in remotes, profiles and templates, keys only known as MSC_SCAN made usable for Triggerhappy, own commands replace audio.conf defaults per remote, optional phone page (Mobile Remote).
author: josh2000

volumio_info.details: Makes RF/IR remote keys usable in Volumio - including keys the kernel driver only reports as MSC_SCAN (e.g. X10 WTI RF receiver 0bc7:0006 with ati_remote). A wizard reads in all keys of a remote, lets you name them and assign Volumio commands or radio stations, and saves everything as a profile (description, notes, up to 6 pictures) in /data/INTERNAL/X10. Templates for known remotes are included; own profiles can be saved as templates. Own commands for keys that already have a Volumio default replace it for that remote only; audio.conf is never modified. Includes a live key test page and an optional phone page (Mobile Remote) with 20 assignable buttons. Kernel and drivers are not modified.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.67.2: source comments translated to English; key names of the new templates in all five languages; texts for eleven error codes that had none; 0.67.1: nothing is loaded or registered at boot any more (uinput autoload file and udev rule of older versions are removed, the mapper service handles both itself); a failed installation leaves no files behind; install/uninstall scripts are executable; no pending timer after the plugin is stopped (full history: CHANGELOG.md)
